title: [nightly/design] Scan: cancel a read, and say when it's taking longer than usual
summary: While a scorecard is being read, golfers can now press Cancel to go back to their photo (to retake it or type the scores in) instead of waiting out a read that can take most of a minute, and after 20 seconds the screen says the read is taking longer than usual.
reviewFirst: frontend/src/pages/scan/useScanPageViewModel.ts: the read's AbortController, cancelRead, ignoring an aborted result, the slow timer
frontend/src/pages/scan/ScanSessionProvider.tsx / scanSession.ts: readingRef kept beside the session so Cancel works after leaving Scan
frontend/src/pages/scan/components/ScanProcessingStep.tsx and present.ts: Cancel and the slow note's wording
frontend/src/brand/components/ScanProgress.tsx: the new optional note inside the live region
frontend/src/lib/api.ts, data/scanRepository.ts: the signal threaded to fetch
stillOpen: PR not opened: git push and the GitHub API return 403 (repo not in this session's authorized set). Patch and notes are in the Project as claude/nightly-design-2026-11-15.patch / .md.
8 macOS screenshot baselines need CI's renders: scan-processing (desktop, mobile, dark x2), ScanProcessingStep preview (light, dark), ScanProgress preview (light, dark).
Reviewer screenshots (10 PNGs) couldn't be stored: no push to factory-artifacts.
next: Cancel and the slow note on the landing page's try-it scan (same ScanProgress, same dead end)
A quiet 'Stopped' line by the photo after a cancel, if golfers miss that they're back where they were
